tools.name: reverse_charge_certificate
tools.description: Generate an EU Art. 196 reverse-charge eligibility verdict for a B2B service invoice between two EU Member States. Validates the customer's VAT ID via VIES and returns a printable certificate. Returns INELIGIBLE for same-country, non-EU, or invalid VAT cases.

tools.name: vat_number_check
tools.description: Validate a single EU/UK VAT identifier against VIES (EU) or HMRC (UK). Returns name + address when available.

tools.name: vat_rate_lookup
tools.description: Look up the applicable VAT rate for a country (and optional rate type), sourced from the EU TEDB (Taxes in Europe Database).

tools.name: vat_registration_check
tools.description: Determine whether a business needs to register for VAT in a given country, given customer type and annual revenue.

tools.name: vat_compliance_full
tools.description: Run the full 10-question VAT compliance gap analysis. Returns compliance score (0–100), risk band, itemised findings with Article citations, and source verification per finding.
